messages:
sara_csm: Weekly finops snapshot for AcmeCo — focused on hosted API commit vs run-rate. Commit = $50,000/mo. 7-day run-rate extrapolated = $248,000/mo. Embeddings route (/v1/embeds) is driving most of the delta. Quick numbers: 7d tokens=14.2M, embeddings calls +132% vs baseline, p95 latency 210ms, error rate 0.6% with a 2.1% spike yesterday at ~06:12 UTC. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood.ai/r/acme/finops :eyes:

devin_billing: yikes. saw the notif. Is the spike sustained or a single batch run? can we apply a soft cap while we investigate? :thinking_face:

usage-bot: :rotating_light: Anomaly detected — account=AcmeCo route=/v1/embeds percent_increase=132% baseline_window=7d generated_ticket=CS-4823

ashok_retro: looks like a recurring daily job — unclear if it's legitimate traffic or a dev script. will check their recent logs and auth key usage. if it's a scheduled batch we should throttle at the API layer, not block.

eva_eng: digging into runtime traces now. early signal: uploader-service v2.1 started a new daily ingest at 02:00 UTC last week, bypassing our KV prefix cache which caused repeated full-context embed calls instead of incremental. if confirmed, we can: 1) push a batching change to uploader to use incremental keys, 2) add a temporary per-key soft quota, 3) route embeddings to smaller-embed model while they patch.

devin_billing: I can create a temporary commit buffer to prevent immediate overage and preserve customer experience. need approval from Sara to apply a $30k buffer for this month. also recommend adjusting alert thresholds to avoid noisy flags.

sara_csm: approve $30k buffer for March, Devin please attach approval note in billing portal. @eva_eng @ashok_retro prioritize a fix — ETA EOD for a mitigation (batcher or fallback to embed-small). I'll update the renewal health: current renewal risk = elevated (usage overshoot + negotiation leverage reduced).

eva_eng: quick mitigation patch ready — will deploy a canary that forces uploader -> incremental batching and fallback to embed-small when per-key tokens > 100k/day. pushing to canary in 15m. command I used locally: curl -X POST https://internal-api.redwood/v1/controls/quota -H 'Authorization: Bearer xxxxx' -d '{\"account\":\"acmeco\",\"soft_limit\":100000}'

ashok_retro: created incident note in CS tracker and added root-cause checklist. ticket CS-4823 assigned to @eva_eng. also scheduled a short sync with AcmeCo ops for tomorrow 9am PT to review batching best practices and to offer an enablement doc.

devin_billing: buffer applied and billing note saved. sending heads-up email to finance leads. :white_check_mark:

usage-bot: update: embeddings surge dropped to +18% after canary rollout at 2712350200. monitor=active next_check=2h

sara_csm: nice work team. action items: EVA — confirm full rollout and post before/after token counts; ASHOK — run the customer enablement call and add a recommended SDK snippet to docs; DEVIN — confirm buffer and update the commit forecast. I'll mark this account as "watchlist" for the renewal deck and follow up Friday 10am PT. Thanks everyone. :pray:
